title: MB NDE 3743
content: My experience occurred during anesthesia (narcosis) that I received after the birth of my son. The birth was normal, but very painful and I suffered a great deal. The truth is acute suffering marked my whole pregnancy. I really wanted the anesthesia because I needed something to calm me down after such a traumatic event. As soon as I was given the anesthesia, I started walking through a rose-colored tunnel clothed in a very soft dress. I perceived that I was in another dimension, a parallel universe. I heard loud, strong noises. I had many sensations and my senses were sharpened. The light was different from normal, whiter and more brilliant. The 'air' seemed very heavy, but I felt my body to be very light. Yes, there was a lightness because I seemed to practically float in this tunnel and from time to time, I felt the floor and the walls. It was pleasing and I felt sort of like a child. Afterwards, the tunnel turned a light yellow and I saw a female 'being' appear in order to accompany me. We finally arrived at a light and then a room appeared - sort of a control room - where there were people behind one-way mirrors. I heard someone say that I had arrived at a parallel universe at a HIGHER LEVEL OF CONSCIOUSNESS where it was possible to see other people living normally upon the earth. That was a great revelation. The secret to the universe was presented to me. The secret is that there is another world where things really are real, where truth, goodness and harmony exist. Life is not limited to the earth experience. Earth life is only a small part of the whole. Those who earn the right are shown eternal life. That was the essence. At a certain moment, I saw God. He was 'something', a powerful presence, but I don't know exactly how to explain it. He told me he knew of the many sacrifices I had made in bringing my children into the world and he had me remember each one of them. Then he told me that my faith had been tested, that I was a good person and that I should rest, do good deeds and that I could return to my native land. I was greatly relieved. And also, God told me I would be eternally blessed. Afterwards, a voice asked me, 'You can choose to die or return to live on the earth. Which do you choose?' I hesitated for a few seconds because life on earth seemed far too painful. There was even a countdown. Time was running out and I realized that if I didn't decide rapidly, I wouldn't have a second chance to return to earth. I decided to continue living. I gathered all my strength, all my focus and energy to return. They were a few minutes of great effort and anguish, fear of not being able to return in a state of normal consciousness. The struggle was so real, so strenuous, that I can say I practically 'sweated'. During the transition back between the two worlds, I could see the birthing room, the equipment, the lights, the ceiling, and I heard the people but my perceptions were very different from normal. Similar to a hallucination. After about ten minutes of altered perceptions, I was finally able to regain consciousness. I said something to show myself that I had for sure returned as normal.

arrival.other_being_detail: A female 'being' appeared to accompany her; later she saw God as a powerful presence.

environment.environment_other_detail: Rose-colored tunnel that turned light yellow; a room appeared "sort of a control room" with people behind one-way mirrors.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She decided to continue living because she realized that if she did not decide quickly (during a countdown), she would not have a second chance to return to earth.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred during anesthesia (narcosis) received after the birth of her son.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Control-room setting with one-way mirrors; "higher level of consciousness" and ability to see people on earth; countdown to decide whether to die or return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel experience preceded arrival in a control-room-like environment; encounter with God and a choice/countdown occurred before return perceptions of the birthing room.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: During the transition back, she could see and hear the birthing room while perceptions were altered.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A "control room" with people behind one-way mirrors; described as a parallel universe at a "higher level of consciousness" where it was possible to see people living on earth; a countdown to decide whether to die or return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "You can choose to die or return to live on the earth. Which do you choose?"; "I had arrived at a parallel universe at a HIGHER LEVEL OF CONSCIOUSNESS"; "The secret is that there is another world where things really are real, where truth, goodness and harmony exist."
